name: FastAPI Production
title: FastAPI Production Services & Async Pydantic Rules
description: Production rules for high-throughput FastAPI microservices using Pydantic v2, asyncpg, dependency injection, and strict exception handlers.
procedures:
1. Context Inspection: Inspect app routers, lifespan handlers, and Alembic database migrations.
2. Architecture: Colocate domain schemas, repositories, and API routers with dependency injection.
3. Implementation: Leverage async def endpoints, Pydantic v2 BaseModel, and Result types.
4. Verification: Run pytest -v with anyio and verify zero blocking I/O calls.
customDirectives:
- Banned: Never execute synchronous I/O operations (e.g. requests.get, time.sleep) inside async route handlers.
- Dependency Rule: Use Depends() for database session lifecycle and authentication.
- Error Handling: Raise HTTPException with structured error schemas; never expose raw tracebacks in responses.
